create_vit_classification: create a Vision Transformer for image classification with configurable patch size and depth
build_vat_action_predictor: build a Video Action Transformer model that predicts action chunks from video frames with task and advantage conditioning
test_vit_forward_pass: test the ViT forward pass with return_hiddens to extract intermediate layer representations
run_vat_training_step: run a VAT training step by passing images and target actions to compute L1 loss and backpropagate
test_vit_attention_cross_attend: test the Attention class with cross_attend flag to query from one sequence and attend to a different context sequence
